texts: Blood cardioplegia allows complete recovery of function even after 4 hours of arrest: B is the answer.
The blood carries oxygen, buffers and natural antioxidants to the arrested heart.
It is not the only method of arrest, it is not limited to arrests shorter than 2 hours, and it can be given warm as well as cold.
Memory hook: the clock reaches 4, and the fan bursts back into motion at full speed.
